landscape.headline: Agentic Storefronts now live across ChatGPT, Copilot, Google AI Mode & Gemini
landscape.body: Shopify merchants get out-of-the-box access to major AI channels managed centrally from Shopify Admin. A new Agentic plan even lets non-Shopify brands push products into the catalog to surface inside ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot. This is the single biggest distribution shift for baby/kids DTC — clients need their feeds clean and structured to be eligible.

landscape.headline: OpenAI retreats on Instant Checkout, pivots ChatGPT to product discovery
landscape.body: OpenAI said the first Instant Checkout 'did not offer the level of flexibility we aspire to,' so merchants now use their own checkout while OpenAI focuses on discovery. Implication: the AEO battleground is citation/recommendation in the answer, not the buy button — exactly Cowy's lane.

landscape.headline: Google AI Overviews now appear on 14% of shopping queries
landscape.body: A 5.6x increase in four months per an analysis of 20.9M shopping keywords. Baby/kids research-heavy queries (safety, materials, age-appropriateness) are prime AI Overview territory, raising the value of structured, citable content.

landscape.headline: Perplexity adds PayPal in-chat checkout, memory personalization & virtual try-on
landscape.body: Perplexity shopping is now personalized via memory and supports PayPal-powered in-chat purchase. Another AI surface where product feeds and review signals decide visibility. [unverified] exact US rollout breadth for apparel try-on beyond initial launch.

cannabis.priority: Do NOT let clients bank on Schedule III to fix AI visibility. With ~28% of cannabis prompts producing AI refusals and ChatGPT recommending only 1.2% of locations, today's move is the fundamentals that actually earn citations: third-party review volume + editorial seeding + structured, citable content. Brief every compliance-constrained client this week.

landscape.headline: Schedule III rescheduling + DCC emergency dual-license rule; June 29 adult-use hearing
landscape.body: DOJ rescheduled medical marijuana to Schedule III (Apr 22, 2026); an expedited hearing on broadening to adult use begins June 29. California's DCC issued an emergency action (announced May 18) letting ~1,600 licensees hold separate adult-use and medical licenses simultaneously. Big operational shift, but does not loosen AI-platform content gating.

landscape.source: 5W PR AI Visibility Index / Hemp Gazette (SOCi)
landscape.headline: Cannabis AI visibility declining despite Google gains; refusals dominate
landscape.body: 5W's Q1 2026 index (50+ consumer-intent prompts across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AIO) found ChatGPT recommends only 1.2% of locations, Perplexity 7.4%, Gemini 11%, and ~28% of cannabis prompts yield refusals/hedges — the highest of any consumer category. SOCi separately reports dispensary AI visibility falling even as Google search visibility rises. Winners just do the fundamentals consistently.

landscape.headline: Tighter SMS enforcement: one-to-one consent, 10DLC, carrier content blocks
landscape.body: FCC one-to-one consent (consent can't be shared across partners) plus 10DLC registration is now table stakes; statutory damages run $500–$1,500 per message. Carrier content policies (CTIA) still block much cannabis SMS regardless of TCPA compliance — pushing brands toward owned, citable web content over outbound SMS.
